about_the_game:
Aerosoft and Simuverse Interactive have finally announced the long-awaited Winter Resort Simulator 3. Immerse yourself in the diverse and dynamic world of alpine management and lead your ski resort to success!

Thanks to the powerful Unreal Engine 5, the third game in the WRS series sets new standards in terms of graphics, immersion, and visual detail. Take control of officially licensed snow groomers as you navigate a picturesque, snow-covered winter landscape, and master the operation of accurately recreated cable cars – both in single-player and in multiplayer mode.

  • The long-awaited successor to Winter Resort Simulator 2 has finally been announced!

  • A completely new level of visual quality powered by Unreal Engine 5

  • Authentic, fully licensed snow groomers recreated in stunning detail

  • Sophisticated operation of carefully designed cableway systems

  • A richly varied, newly designed game world with a significantly expanded size

  • Deep modding support offering countless creative possibilities

  • Engaging single-player experience and cooperative multiplayer gameplay

  • Announced for Winter 2026 on PC and consoles

  • Drive accurately recreated snow groomers through scenic winter landscapes, groom slopes, and move snow to ensure perfect skiing conditions

  • Use the snowcats' powerful winch system to safely master even the steepest slopes

  • Deploy fully licensed snow cannons to produce enough artificial snow for smooth operations

  • Keep a close eye on your finances to lead your resort to economic success – even under challenging weather conditions!

  • Experience exciting missions with a wide range of objectives and challenges

  • Play solo or team up with friends in the engaging multiplayer mode

  • Create your own vehicles and missions using the extensive modding tools available

  • Discover completely redesigned ropeways, now featuring several new types of lifts

  • Operate fully licensed installations with ultra-realistic stations and accurately simulated control systems

  • Learn how to master the ropeways, assisted by interactive tutorials

  • Feed and park your lifts to ensure seamless operation and happy guests

  • Complete thrilling, cableway-focused missions with varying levels of difficulty

  • Join forces with your friends in multiplayer mode and work together to manage the entire resort efficiently!

Winter Resort Simulator 3 has just been announced for release in winter 2026 - make sure to wishlist the game now so you don't miss any exciting news!

  • Graphics: GPU NVIDIA 3060 or AMD RX 6600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 50 GB available space
